title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 31
description: Ten questions on Genesis 31: Jacob leaves Laban, Rachel takes the teraphim, and Jacob and Laban make a covenant at the heap.

questions.text: What did Yahweh tell Jacob after Laban's attitude toward him changed?
questions.explanation: Laban's face was not toward Jacob as before, and Yahweh said, "Return to the land of your fathers, and to your relatives, and I will be with you."

answers.text: Stay with Laban seven more years
Return to the land of his fathers

questions.text: According to Jacob, how many times had Laban changed his wages?
questions.explanation: Jacob told Rachel and Leah, "Your father has deceived me, and changed my wages ten times, but God didn't allow him to hurt me."

questions.text: How did the angel of God identify himself in Jacob's dream?
questions.explanation: In the dream he said, "I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar, where you vowed a vow to me."

questions.text: What did Rachel steal while Laban was shearing his sheep?
questions.explanation: Laban had gone to shear his sheep, and Rachel stole the teraphim that were her father's.

answers.text: The best rams of Laban's flock
The teraphim that were her father's

questions.text: On which day was Laban told that Jacob had fled?
questions.explanation: Laban was told on the third day that Jacob had fled.

questions.text: What did God warn Laban in a dream of the night?
questions.explanation: God came to Laban in a dream and said, "Be careful that you don't speak to Jacob either good or bad."

answers.text: To make a covenant with Jacob
Not to speak to Jacob either good or bad

questions.text: Where did Rachel hide the teraphim when Laban searched her tent?
questions.explanation: Rachel had put the teraphim in the camel's saddle and sat on them, and Laban felt around the tent but did not find them.

answers.text: Under an oak tree near the tents
In the camel's saddle, sitting on them
In Leah's tent among her things
In a pit among the sheep pens

questions.text: For how many years did Jacob say he served Laban for his flock?
questions.explanation: Jacob said, "I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your flock."

questions.text: What did Jacob call the heap of stones?
questions.explanation: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, but Jacob called it Galeed.

questions.text: What did Laban do early in the morning before he returned to his place?
questions.explanation: Early in the morning Laban rose up, kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them. Then he returned to his place.

answers.text: He offered a sacrifice on the mountain
He kissed his sons and daughters and blessed them
He took his daughters back home
